description: Generate a deep link to the Event Escapes event detail page. The user lands on a page where they can review ticket categories, see hotels near the venue (auto-loaded), and complete booking themselves. Optionally pass hotel_id to pin a recommended hotel at the top of the hotels-near-venue list. This does not make a reservation; it is a navigation link only. Package pages are linked by build_package_link.

check_in.description: Optional check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD) to pre-fill on the page.

check_out.description: Optional check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD) to pre-fill on the page.

guests.description: Number of travellers as stated by the user. Optional, with no default: omit it when the number of travellers is unknown.

hotel_id.description: Optional hotel ID from search_hotels_near_event. If provided, this hotel will be pinned to the top of the hotels-near-venue list on the event page.

name: build_event_link
